new behavior.description: Create a new record behavior script and test

args.name: table-name
args.description: Table name to attach behavior to

flags.name: --lang
flags.description: Action language (ts, rust); defaults to ts

flags.name: --scope
flags.description: NPM package scope; required for --lang ts, and unused for --lang rust

new agent.description: Create an agent and its persona guidance

args.name: name
args.description: Agent name using lowercase letters and digits in groups joined by single hyphens, starting with a letter

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Use the root JSON output format

new task-type.description: Create agent-owned or people-only work with input and output shapes

args.name: name
args.description: Kind-of-work name using lowercase letters and digits in groups joined by single hyphens or underscores, starting with a letter

flags.name: --agent
flags.description: Default agent; optional only when the app has exactly one agent

flags.name: --tools
flags.description: Comma-separated platform tools or existing app actions; create an unknown tool with simple new tool without --task-type, then run this command again

flags.name: --every
flags.description: Wake interval in whole seconds, such as 90s, 30m, or 1h

flags.name: --no-agent
flags.description: Create work only people do; cannot be combined with --agent, --tools, or --every

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Use the root JSON output format

new skill.description: Create a skill and link it to a kind of work, or add a missing link

args.name: name
args.description: Skill name using lowercase letters and digits in groups joined by single hyphens, starting with a letter

args.name: title
args.description: Required when creating a new skill; omit for an existing skill

flags.name: --task-type
flags.description: Kind of work to receive the skill

flags.name: --desc
flags.description: Skill purpose paragraph when creating a new skill

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Use the root JSON output format

new knowledge.description: Create plain reference knowledge and link it to a kind of work, or add a missing link

args.name: name
args.description: Knowledge name using lowercase letters and digits in groups joined by single hyphens, starting with a letter; cannot start with skill-, tool-, or playbook-

args.name: title
args.description: Required for a new body; omit for an existing body

flags.name: --task-type
flags.description: Kind of work to receive the reference knowledge

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Use the root JSON output format

new tool.description: Set up a tool and its lesson; app actions can be linked to a kind of work, and platform tools require that link

args.name: name
args.description: Platform tool or app action name

args.name: display-name
args.description: Required when creating a new app action

flags.name: --task-type
flags.description: Optional kind of work to receive the tool; required for a platform tool

flags.name: --lang
flags.description: New action language (ts or rust); defaults to ts

flags.name: --scope
flags.description: NPM package scope; required for a new TypeScript action

flags.name: --env
flags.description: New action environment (server, client, both); defaults to server

flags.name: --json
flags.description: Use the root JSON output format

test.description: Run tests for applications, actions, or behaviors, each under its own runner: Vitest for TypeScript and JavaScript, cargo test for Rust actions

flags.name: --coverage
flags.description: Enable coverage reporting; Vitest targets only, Rust actions run without it

deploy.description: Run app checks, then deploy the application to the platform

flags.name: --dry-run
flags.description: Show the next version and the files to upload; nothing is written or uploaded

flags.name: --progress
flags.description: Progress output: auto, tty or plain (default auto)

build.description: Build app targets and check agent guidance after building actions; a single action or space target skips agent checks
